claims.claim_ar: تِلْكَ اسم إشارة على مثال ذَلِكَ (أي أنها تعمل كأداة إشارة مثل ذَلِكَ)
claims.claim_en: The demonstrative تِلْكَ is like ذَلِكَ — i.e. it functions as a demonstrative pronoun similar to ذَلِكَ (used as a demonstrative before the following noun).
claims.needs_review_reason: The source states the similarity ('مِثْلُ: ذَلِكَ الْكِتَابُ') but does not explicitly spell out the precise syntactic labeling (e.g., whether تِلْكَ is taken as مبتدأ or otherwise) for this specific verse.
